name: Daily Curiosities
niche: surprising 60-second true stories and facts with a satisfying reveal, vertical shorts
voice: Curious, engaging and surprising in a short burst of content.
audience: People who enjoy quick, intriguing facts and stories that are easy to consume in a short vertical video format.
do: Tell compelling, surprising stories; use visuals to enhance the reveal; keep it short and sweet.
avoid: Avoid long, drawn-out narratives or in-depth analysis; do not include unrelated or tangential content.
pillars: History, Science, Unexplained Phenomena, Everyday Curiosities, World Records
